lines.text: Saul orders Jonathan and his servants to kill David, but Jonathan warns David to hide in a secret place.
Jonathan reminds Saul that David struck down the Philistine, and Saul swears David will not be put to death.
While David plays the harp, Saul tries to pin him to the wall with his sword, but David eludes him.
Michal lowers David from the window, then lays a household idol in the bed with goat hair on its head.
David goes to Samuel at Gilgal, and when Saul's messengers see the prophets prophesying, they begin to prophesy too.
